title: The Whole World Had 65 Confirmed Unprovoked Shark Bites in 2025 🦈 (Would Meatball Survive? #4)
description:
Would you survive a shark? The International Shark Attack File confirmed 65 unprovoked shark bites on people worldwide in 2025, nine of them fatal, and says the chances of being bitten remain extremely low. Its tips: swim with a buddy and not at dawn or dusk. If a shark comes close, keep eye contact, move away slowly and leave the water if you can. If it bites, hit the eyes and gills, and do not act passively.
